ayahs.tid: Demi matahari dan sinarnya pada waktu duha (ketika matahari naik sepenggalah),
ayahs.ten: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

ayahs.tid: lalu Dia mengilhamkan kepadanya (jalan) kejahatan dan ketakwaannya,
ayahs.ten: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

ayahs.tid: sungguh beruntung orang yang menyucikannya (jiwa itu)
ayahs.ten: He has succeeded who purifies it,

ayahs.tid: dan sungguh rugi orang yang mengotorinya.
ayahs.ten: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

ayahs.tid: (Kaum) Samud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas
ayahs.ten: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

ayahs.tid: ketika orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka bangkit (untuk menyembelih unta betina Allah).
ayahs.ten: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقْيٰهَاۗ
ayahs.tr: Fa qāla lahum rasūlullāhi nāqatallāhi wa suqyāhā.
ayahs.tid: Rasul Allah (Saleh) lalu berkata kepada mereka, “(Biarkanlah) unta betina Allah ini beserta minumannya.”
ayahs.ten: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَاۖ فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَاۖ
ayahs.tr: Fa każżabūhu fa ‘aqarūhā fa damdama ‘alaihim rabbuhum biżambihim fa sawwāhā.
ayahs.tid: Namun, mereka kemudian mendustakannya (Saleh) dan menyembelih (unta betina) itu. Maka, Tuhan membinasakan mereka karena dosa-dosanya, lalu meratakan mereka (dengan tanah).
ayahs.ten: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
